entities.name: Calix
entities.description: A Theran Nyxborn human and former planeswalker created by Klothys to pursue Elspeth Tirel and reweave her into Fate.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: The god of Destiny who created Calix.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who escaped the Underworld, whom Calix pursues.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The god awaiting Elspeth at the Underworld's exit, whom she defeated.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The god who granted Elspeth life in gratitude for defeating Heliod.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: The realm souls escaped from during the war of the gods.

entities.name: Agents of Fate
entities.description: Agents Klothys dispatched to stop escaped souls.

entities.name: War of the Gods
entities.description: The war during which countless souls escaped the Underworld.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: The event in which Calix lost his spark.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Calix returned to Theros.

events.summary: Klothys is furious that souls escaped the Underworld and weaves the Agent of Fate Calix to pursue Elspeth.
events.quote: Klothys weaved her masterpiece — the Agent of Fate called Calix.

events.summary: Elspeth repeatedly clashes with Calix on her way out of the Underworld and defeats him each time, finally at the exit where Heliod awaits.
events.quote: she defeated him one final time as she reached the exit where Heliod awaited her

events.summary: Elspeth defeats Heliod and is granted life by Erebos, then planeswalks away; Calix sparks and planeswalks after her.
events.quote: until he sparked and planeswalked after her for their destined confrontation

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Calix returns to Theros before losing his spark in the Great Pruning.
events.quote: before losing his spark in the Great Pruning

relations.quote: He was created by Klothys , the god of Destiny

relations.note: created solely to carry out her will
relations.quote: Created solely to carry out the will of Klothys
